    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    AppState
    Root persisted state of the application.
    AuthManager
    Privacy lock (PIN) manager for US #12.
    Category
    Budget category (e.g., Food, Transport).
    Cycle
    Budget cycle metadata persisted in SQLite.
    CycleManager
    Handles budget cycle setup and cycle-based calculations.
    CycleManager.RolloverResult
    Result returned after checking whether daily rollover changed the cycle calculation date.
    CycleManager.ThresholdResult
    Result returned from threshold checks (US #6).
    DashboardUI
    Console dashboard screen (US #3, #4, #5, #6).
    DatabaseHelper
    Loads and saves application state in Paths.APP_DB using SQLite.
    DateFormats
    Date parsing/formatting utilities for console input/output.
    Expense
    A single spending transaction.
    ExpenseManager
    Expense operations used by history flows (US #2, #7, #8, #9).
    HistoryUI
    Console history screen (US #7, #8, #9).
    Main
    Application entry point.
    MenuUI
    Main console menu and startup router.
    Notifications
    Sends push notifications using ntfy (HTTP POST).
    Paths
    Central file-system paths used by the application.
    ReportManager
    Reporting / dashboard calculations.
    ReportManager.SpendingInsight
    A stable structure for the UI to print.
    SettingsUI
    Console settings screen (privacy lock + reset cycle).
    SetupUI
    Console setup screen for initial budget cycle setup.
    UserSettings
    User settings persisted in AppState.
